upstream.description: #1 Persistent memory for AI coding agents based on real-world benchmarks

classification.analysis: agentmemory is a persistent memory server for AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, and 15+ others), built on the 'iii' engine and installed via npx as a local memory daemon on port 3111. It captures session context automatically via hooks and exposes 54 MCP tools plus a REST API so any MCP-speaking agent can recall prior work instead of re-deriving it, with a real-time viewer and no external database dependency. Benchmarked against long-context memory tasks claiming 95% retrieval recall and 92% fewer tokens. Aimed at developers running multiple coding agents who want shared, durable context across tools and sessions.

use_cases.title: Give a coding agent persistent memory across sessions
Share context between Claude Code, Codex and Cursor on the same project
Stop re-explaining project architecture to an agent every session
Benchmark agent memory recall quality against LongMemEval
